- **PD-5302**, from #central-random. Hollis posted on 14 Oct that it's another Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week. The message gives no other detail.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because both belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. I couldn't see any CRM or ticket files for Marrow Fieldworks, so there may be tickets there that aren't on the list, and I told Pree that.

I only read sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, #general, #help-it-ops and Moss's public notes. I didn't use message search.
